title: Wardrobe: snap a pile of clothes, get clean cutouts draped on a photo of you

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Snap a photo of a pile of clothes on your bed and Wardrobe pulls out every garment as its own clean product cutout, no background, then optionally drapes each piece onto a modeled photo of you. The app keeps its image library and JSON database local, while bundled codec skills can import entire folders or assemble new outfit ideas. It feels like a personal inventory system built around clothes you actually
